snippet.title: Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition - Comparative Trailer
snippet.description:
Same nightmare. More vivid. More intense.

Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition comes to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC on 10th October, 2025. 

Available immediately for anyone that preorders a digital edition of Little Nightmares III on PlayStation, Xbox, and PC.
